summary: Re-test of iteration 23 frontend gating bugs. Both bugs fixed and verified via Playwright DOM queries against the production preview URL. (1) Auditor (auditor_ui@test.com) sidebar now renders EXACTLY ['Dashboard','Auditorias'] - all six forbidden modules (Incidentes, Documentos, Matriz IPER, Capacitacion, Reportes, Implementacion) correctly hidden. Layout.js L72 now gates Incidentes by canReportIncidents = permissions?.can_report_incidents, which the backend returns false for auditor. (2) sgsst_manager (sgsst_ui@test.com) on /audits page: of 4 audit rows, only 1 row shows Acta Apertura + Acta Cierre buttons (the closed audit TEST_IT24_closed_670ea1); the remaining three (including TEST_IT24_open_f3344d previously buggy) correctly suppress the buttons. Audits.js L280 now gates buttons with canDownloadReports && (isPrivRole || ['closed','reviewed'].includes(a.status)) and isPrivRole = ['admin','owner','auditor'].includes(user?.role) correctly excludes sgsst_manager. (3) Auditor Consolidado tab of first audit renders the AI Narrative Editor (data-testid=ai-narrative-editor) with all three subsections narrative-narrative_opening / narrative-narrative_closing / narrative-narrative_report, each with its Generar con IA and Guardar buttons (3 ai-generate-* and 3 ai-save-* data-testids present). Regressions: admin nav shows all 12 items (8 modules + Consolidado/Empresas/Usuarios/Alertas Email); collaborator nav shows only Dashboard + Incidentes. All four user flows pass.

sgsst_manager /audits: 3 of 4 rows correctly hide Acta buttons (only 1 Cerrada row shows them)

critical_code_review_comments: Layout.js L53,L72: canReportIncidents correctly derived from permissions.can_report_incidents and applied as show-filter for Incidentes nav item. Pattern consistent with other can_view_* flags.

Audits.js L258-280: AuditList destructures canDownloadReports+user, derives isPrivRole for admin/owner/auditor, then gates Acta buttons with canDownloadReports && (isPrivRole || status in closed/reviewed). Correct role + status combo - sgsst_manager sees buttons only on closed/reviewed audits.
Audits.js L917-920: Same pattern applied in AuditDetail (showPdfDownloads). Consistent with list view.
AINarrativeEditor.jsx correctly exposes data-testids ai-narrative-editor, narrative-<type>, ai-generate-<type>, ai-save-<type> - all verified present in DOM for auditor.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created; used pre-existing TEST_IT24_* audits from iteration 23 (2 open + 2 closed, 1 of them actually in closed state showing Acta buttons).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 23 frontend gating bugs fully resolved. Layout.js gates Incidentes by can_report_incidents; Audits.js AuditList gates Acta buttons by role+status. AINarrativeEditor renders correctly in Consolidado tab. Backend was already 25/25 in iteration 23. Next work can proceed with new features on top of a clean frontend RBAC state.
rca_of_the_issue: Both bugs from iteration 23 were pure UI filter gaps. Fix 1: added canReportIncidents = permissions?.can_report_incidents in Layout.js and set show: canReportIncidents on Incidentes nav entry. Fix 2: in Audits.js AuditList, the Acta buttons were unconditionally rendered for any user with canDownloadReports; adding && (isPrivRole || closed/reviewed status) on the wrapping fragment correctly hides them for sgsst_manager on open audits while preserving access for admin/owner/auditor and for closed/reviewed audits for sgsst_manager. Verified end-to-end via Playwright DOM queries against production preview URL.
